initialExam.title: UPSC EPFO (EO/AO) 2026
initialExam.description: Enforcement Officer/Accounts Officer exam for EPFO. 156 EO/AO + 76 APFC vacancies; 311 EO/AO requisitions withdrawn on 8 Jun 2026. Exam expected December 2026.
initialExam.eligibility: Bachelor's Degree from a recognized University
initialExam.syllabus: General English, Indian Freedom Struggle, Current Events, Indian Polity, Economics & Social Security, Insurance & Labour Laws, General Accounting, Industrial Relations, General Science, General Mental Ability.
initialExam.examPattern: Recruitment Test: 120 questions, 300 marks, 2 hours. Interview: 75 marks.
initialExam.jobRole: Enforcement Officer and Accounts Officer in EPFO offices across India
initialExam.careerGrowth: EO/AO → Regional PF Commissioner → Additional Central PF Commissioner → Central PF Commissioner.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit upsc.gov.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Upload documents 5. Pay fee 6. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Transport Allowance, Medical, LTC, Pension
